experiments.purpose: Freeze the TCGA-LUAD endpoint, prediction time, allowed variables and leakage controls.
Audit aggregate coverage of 522 open-access TCGA-LUAD XML files.
Run the frozen Cox holdout without raw extraction or model persistence.
Use death time for events and latest longitudinal follow-up for censoring.
Add censoring-aware calibration, bootstrap uncertainty and model diagnostics.
Compare Stage, TNM and Stage+TNM protocols without rank-deficient duplicate encodings.
Evaluate three seeds by five folds for every frozen staging protocol.
Train on diagnosis year through 2007 and validate on later cases.
Reproduce the complete active line with portable paths and standards-compliant JSON.
